sources.citation: Ocko SA, King H, Andreen D, Bardunias P, Turner JS, Soar R, Mahadevan L (2017). Solar-powered ventilation of African termite mounds. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 114(40):10620-10624.
Ocko SA, Heyde A, Mahadevan L (2019). Morphogenesis of termite mounds. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 116(9):3379-3384.
King H, Ocko S, Mahadevan L (2015). Termite mounds harness diurnal temperature oscillations for ventilation. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 112(37):11589-11593.
Korb J (2003). Thermoregulation and ventilation of termite mounds. Naturwissenschaften 90(5):212-219.

Oberst SM, Lai JCS, Martin R, Halkon B (2020). Revisiting stigmergy in light of multi-functional, biogenic, termite structures as communication channel. Computational and Structural Biotechnology Journal 18:2522-2534.

macrotermes_cathedral_mound_specimen.species: Fungus-cultivating cathedral termite mound with vertical surface flutes and tapering central spire

governing_equations.section: King, Ocko & Mahadevan (2015) PNAS 112:11589-11593; Ocko et al. (2017) PNAS 114:10620-10624; Ocko, Heyde & Mahadevan (2019) PNAS 116:3379-3384
governing_equations.diurnal_buoyancy_thermosiphon: u_flute(t) = K_buoy * (T_flute(t) - T_chimney(t)),  A_chimney * u_chimney(t) + A_flutes * u_flute(t) = 0
governing_equations.oscillatory_co2_taylor_aris_dispersion: D_eff = D_0 + alpha_TA * u_amp^2,  dC_nest/dt = M_metabolic - (D_eff * A_eff / (V_nest * H)) * (C_nest - C_atm)
governing_equations.pheromone_advection_diffusion_mound_grow: d_t c + u . grad c = D_c * laplacian(c) - gamma_c * c,  v_n = k_dep * max(0, c - c_th) - k_erosion * kappa
governing_equations.peclet_aspect_ratio_law: H / R = 1.0 + eta_Pe * Pe,  H / W = (1.0 + eta_Pe * Pe) / 2.0,  where Pe = u_0 * H_0 / D_c
governing_equations.equatorward_solar_spire_tilt_law: theta_tilt(phi_lat) = chi_solar * |phi_lat|  (Northward tilt in Southern Hemisphere Namibia, |phi_lat| = 19.2 deg S -> theta_tilt = 18.8 deg)

diurnal_thermosiphon_24h_trajectory.regime: Nighttime radiative cooling (flute downdraft / chimney updraft)
Midday peak solar buoyancy (strong flute updraft / chimney downdraft)
